The Chinese characters for Evelyn

As a transliteration, Evelyn is usually written 伊芙琳 (Yī fú lín). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

伊
Yī
he, she (classical)
芙
fú
lotus
琳
lín
beautiful jade

Origin and meaning

The name Evelyn has Germanic roots and means “wished-for child (of uncertain origin)”.
